verdict.rationale: Trivy explicitly documents SBOM generation in both CycloneDX and SPDX formats for images, filesystems, and local projects, with clear supported-format docs. This is a core, well-documented first-party capability, though independent hands-on corroboration specifically of SBOM output (vs. vuln/secret scanning) is thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of actual SBOM file output content and format correctness.
